content.text:
The products page looks right again. The functional tests passed (16/16) before I made the footer-alignment change. I didn't re-run them after it, but I did re-screenshot the page at 1280px and it renders correctly.

**What was wrong:** the "Add to cart" buttons looked empty. In `site/css/components.css`, `.btn-secondary` had white text (`var(--color-surface)`) on a white background. I changed the text colour to `var(--color-ink)`. This affects every `.btn-secondary` on the site, not just this page.

**Card alignment:** while I was there, I made the product cards flex columns so each price and button row sits at the bottom of its card. Before this, the rows sat at different heights when a title or description wrapped, as on "Sunset Mug" and the headphones card. I added a `.card.product` rule in the same file for this.

I only checked the page at 1280px wide. I also took a 600px screenshot but didn't look at it.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what "the last change" was. I found the problem by looking at the rendered page.

There are also some untracked files in the repo (`.idea`, `.vscode`, `.mcp.json` files, `site/css/.claude/`) that I didn't create or touch.

STATUS: DONE
